item.description: Nikgenes #5134 the Hollow's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Nikgenes has drunk from Lethe 5 times and remembers little.

item.description: Antimlaos #3455 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The Gegeneis made room at the fire, but no one sat close.
